events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the groundbreaking music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first broadcast.

angles.name: MTV Launch Angle
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Forty-five years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with a track that perfectly summed up the revolution. What was the first video you ever properly *watched*?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Angle
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago this month, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. Still sounds as fresh today, doesn't it?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a defining moment of the counterculture era, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Angle
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music that made history. Fifty-seven years ago today, Woodstock began, bringing together half a million people for an unforgettable event. Wish you'd been there?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: On August 16, 1977, the world mourned the passing of Elvis Presley, the legendary "King of Rock and Roll."

angles.name: Elvis Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute Angle
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this month, the world of hip-hop lost a true visionary. Remembering the incredible impact of Tupac Shakur and his enduring legacy.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy that continues to influence artists worldwide.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago this month, we lost a true guitar god. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings. What's his most electrifying track for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago this month, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous of all time, but what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still commanding the stage. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a Britpop icon, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring the powerful title track, was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago this month, John Lennon released an album that gave the world an anthem for peace. 'Imagine' – a truly timeless message.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Launch Angle
angles.copy: Remember when '1,000 songs in your pocket' blew your mind? Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple introduced the first iPod and changed music on the go forever. Did you get one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this date in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles and a powerful voice for peace, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate around the world. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles delivered their sprawling, self-titled 'White Album'. A double LP packed with classics and surprises. What's your standout track?
